name: Joanna Szczotka
abstract_title: Consciousness vs sensory connectedness: a large-scale, high-density Neuropixels survey of spiking activity across cortical and subcortical sensory hierarchies in mice
abstract: Probing the mechanisms of consciousness is often inadvertently entangled with probing the mechanisms of sensory connectedness. Experimental assays typically rely on detecting a behavioural response to a stimulus, perceptual report, or evoked potential—treating the ability to register the external world as a proxy for the presence of consciousness itself. field: Integrated information theory, systems neuroscience, consciousness
notable: Co-author with Giulio Tononi on Nature Neuroscience paper; works at Center for Sleep and Consciousness
